decisions.question: Who reviews this PR before it merges?
options: You ask a teammate who knows this code to review it
You state in the PR description what it changes and why that is safe
option_reasons: a teammate who knows the code can check it in one pass
you know the change best, and the account stays on record
when a wrong change here would be cheap to undo
decisions.reason: It costs you one message, and it is the only option where someone else checks the code.
decisions.why: This one needs a second reviewer who knows this code.
